problem:
The sum of all nine $9$th roots of unity is equal to$\,$
{{field-1}}.
worked_solution:
Recall that the principal $9$th root of unity is 

$$
z={e}^{2\pi \text{i}/9}\ne 1,
$$

and that any $9$th root of unity is of the form ${z}^{k}$ for $k=0,1,...,8.$  Also, we have ${z}^{9}=1.$

Using the formula for the sum of a geometric sequence, we obtain that the sum of all eight roots is 

$$
\begin{aligned}1+z+{z}^{2}+{z}^{3}+{z}^{4}+{z}^{5}+{z}^{6}+{z}^{7}+{z}^{8} & =\frac{1\cdot (1-{z}^{9})}{1-z} \\  & =\frac{1\cdot (1-1)}{1-z} \\  & =\frac{1\cdot 0}{1-z} \\  & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
